name: Paperless-ngx MCP
description: Search, read and tag Paperless-ngx documents from an MCP client. Set PAPERLESS_MCP_PAPERLESS_URL and a Paperless API token. MCP endpoint at /mcp. No auth of its own: anyone who reaches it gets the tools, so turn off DNS-resolvable to keep it on the internal network, or put it behind a VPN.
